description: A knob putting out a steady voltage from -5V to 5V, with a text area for writing down what it is patched to

params.text: Sets the output voltage: -5V fully counter-clockwise, 0V at noon and 5V fully clockwise

outputs.text: Carries the voltage set by the knob, -5V to 5V

notes: the dark area on the panel takes typed text, for labelling what the knob controls; the text is saved with the patch
shift-dragging up or down on the module name changes the colour of the panel, and holding ctrl as well makes the change finer
